impact:
CharacterPage.affiliated_organization was a single FK, but the graph gives characters many AFFILIATED_WITH edges. The exporter fanned them out as duplicate character rows and dedupe_by_global_id kept whichever Neo4j emitted first, so the published affiliation was arbitrary and unstable across exports. Brigadier Lethbridge-Stewart published as "Time Lords" (an edge whose own reasoning says "not indicating direct membership") instead of UNIT, which he commands. On the shipped v2.5.0 doctorwho export: 5,459 rows collapsed to 3,992 characters, discarding 1,467 affiliation facts for 1,039 characters (26% of the cast). Organization pages also under-listed their membership, since the FK only held each character's primary tie.

Root cause was the exporter, not the graph: every AFFILIATED_WITH edge already carries relationship_type, confidence and reasoning (4,606/4,607 edges in doctorwho.mega), but the Cypher projected only org.org_uuid.

Fixed under contract v2.6.0: exporter collects ranked affiliations with edge data; new CharacterAffiliation junction model; importer writes all of them and keeps the FK as the ranked head; character page, JSON-LD affiliation array, chat tool payload, org member_count and get_related_characters all read the junction. Pre-v2.6.0 exports still gain affiliations via a pre-dedupe harvest (org identity only, no edge data).
title: Character affiliations were single-FK: 1,467 facts discarded, wrong org published
